title: Seoul expresses regret over Takaichi's offering to controversial war shrine
caption:
Tensions flared between Seoul and Tokyo after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi sent an official ritual offering to Yasukuni Shrine. South Korea's foreign ministry expressed sharp regret, warning that honoring a site linked to wartime aggression undermines regional trust.
